claim: Try it with sample data opens an isolated sample scene and starts a local sound loop.
sandbox: fresh browser context; click the landing action and assert the banner, live source status, and component connection; open /demo?demo=1 directly and press Play before asserting playback

claim: The component has three scenes, intensity control, and motion control.
sandbox: demo route; select a scene, move the intensity slider, and choose static motion

claim: Copy embed includes a complete user-started audio connection for the component.
sandbox: demo route; inspect copied example for its audio element, user play handler, AudioContext, source connection, and scene.connect call

claim: Sample and file audio stay in this tab; the demo sends no API requests and writes no user storage.
where: landing hero, privacy section, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; play sample and generated WAV inputs, record requests, and inspect localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, and OPFS

claim: Audio and microphone input start only after a user action.
where: playground, privacy section, privacy page, and README
sandbox: cold direct /demo?demo=1 with constructor, resume, oscillator, warning, and microphone spies; assert zero audio work before interaction, then exactly one context, one resume, and four oscillators after Play; reload and assert microphone starts only after its control

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
where: landing hero, offline state, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; wait for service worker, set context offline, and reload /demo?demo=1

claim: Automatic motion reduction shows a stable poster when the system reduces motion.
sandbox: fresh browser context with reducedMotion=reduce; compare canvas pixels across time

claim: The local release-candidate tarball includes ESM, CommonJS, TypeScript declarations, component styles, and no runtime dependencies.
sandbox: clean build; pack the tarball, install it in a fresh temporary project, and import both module formats

claim: The documented component attributes and matching properties, audio methods, deterministic poster, accessible label, and custom tag registration work.
sandbox: packed clean TypeScript consumer plus fresh browser context; compile label property assignment, prove two-way label reflection and its accessible name, then exercise the public API with a Web Audio node and custom element name

claim: Building this release candidate requires Node.js 20 or newer.
sandbox: clean checkout; assert the package engine floor and the build-test runtime major version

claim: npm run build:site writes the deployable site with index.html at dist/site/.
sandbox: clean build; assert the site root, index document, route assets, and service worker exist

claim: audio-reactive-scene is not published to npm yet.
sandbox: fresh command context; query npm registry and assert the package name returns its documented not-found response

claim: The library is free under the MIT license.
where: landing hero, terms page, and README
sandbox: repository files; assert package license field and MIT license text

claim: This site does not collect, store, or sell personal data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; exercise the sample demo and assert no off-origin/API requests and no local, session, IndexedDB, or OPFS user data
